comment.body: Thanks for testing the additional settings combinations and sharing the screenshots. The named `hello world.txt` result can be identical for `Aa` (Title case) and `Aa Aa` (Capitalize Each Word). Could you share one exact filename containing a connecting word (for example, `hello and world.txt`) and the exact preview from each button?
